tracks.title: How the work runs
tracks.blurb: Still early. How you send work and get notes back, and the simple board we use (to do, doing, done: that is Kanban; a short weekly plan is the useful part of Scrum).

items.watchWhen: Watch when you start the studio project. Kanban is the board. Scrum is the weekly plan. We use both, simply.
